title: Classical guitar concert video, 18 s excerpt (archive.org, CC BY-SA 4.0)
what: Real classical guitar performance video (nylon strings, played with the fingers), 18 s excerpt (400-418 s) of a 28-minute concert recording; 640x480, 30000/1001 fps, progressive. Multi-camera edit: medium shot of the seated player from the front at a slight angle (guitar neck and fretting hand at the upper right of the player, picking hand at the sound hole partly behind a microphone stand) from 0 to 7.27 s, a wide shot of the stage (player small in frame, a music stand in front of the lower guitar body) from 7.27 to 14.65 s, and the medium shot again from 14.65 s to the end (cut times from ffmpeg scene score > 0.12). The piece played is not identified in the item's metadata. No ground truth.

source.attribution: "Crescendo 313 - DRH - Meredith Connie Solo Classical Guitar - Part II", Mark Andersen / Seattle Community Media, archive.org item scm-422828-crescendo313-drh-meredithconn, CC BY-SA 4.0; excerpt 400-418 s, re-encoded.
